Father of Sidsel "Cecilia" Tygesdatter Brahe; Magdelene Brahe; Elizabeth Tengnagel; Kirstine Brahe; Jørgen Thycosen Brahe; Thyge Thycosen Brahe; Claus Brahe; Sophie Brahe and Otte Brahe
